Actual Demand for June

actual_demand_june.Rd

A dataset containing operation demand information across regions for June 2024.

Usage

actual_demand_june

Format

A data frame with 7200 rows and 9 variables:

REGIONID

character, region identifier

INTERVAL_DATETIME

character, datetime of each demand interval

OPERATIONAL_DEMAND

integer, recorded operational demand

OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_ADJUSTMENT

integer, adjustment to the operational demand

WDR_ESTIMATE

integer, wholesale demand response estimate

LASTCHANGED

character, timestamp of the last update

DATE

character, date of the demand record

TIME

character, time of the demand record
